Maya Singh: Hi team — I put in my resignation today. My last day will be 2026-07-16. A couple of things to confirm: benefits cutoff, COBRA eligibility (I was on contractor->full-time conversion last year), visa paperwork implications, and how to return my dev laptop and external monitor.

Ethan (People Ops): Thanks, Maya. We see the notice and have set your last day to 2026-07-16. Benefits (health/dental/vision) end at 11:59pm PT on your last day. COBRA window is 60 days from loss-of-coverage; packet mailed/emailed within ~7 business days. We'll also loop in Legal for visa-related questions.

Maya Singh: Re: COBRA — I briefly was a contractor in 2024 but converted to full-time in Jan 2025. Am I treated like any regular FT employee?

Ethan (People Ops): Yes — since you were full-time at the time of separation you're eligible for COBRA the same as other FT employees. The admin will confirm when they send the packet.

Legal (Immigration): Hi Maya — for visa sponsorship: HR will close out the current case and provide the final employment verification letter. If you have dependent paperwork, share it with legal@redwood.com and we'll advise on timelines. There may be post-termination grace periods depending on visa class — we'll DM you the specifics.

Priya (IT): Equipment options: (A) drop off at HQ reception, (B) prepaid label to personal address, (C) ship via our courier. For remote folks we usually send a label 7 days before your last day. SSO deprovisioning normally happens 6pm PT on last day; we can delay a few hours on request. Please back up personal files, remove personal SSH keys, and confirm if you'd like delegated inbox access for Rohit during the transition.

Maya Singh: Please send a FedEx label to maya.s.personal+returns@gmail.com. I'd like inbox delegate to Rohit for two weeks and SSO kept until 8pm PT on last day to finish a client demo.

Priya (IT): FedEx label scheduled for 2026-07-09 to that email, tracking TX555666777. We'll hold SSO until 8pm PT on 2026-07-16. We'll also provision a short-lived admin account for Rohit and put creds into 1Password.

Rohit (Manager): Thanks Maya — can you prepare a two-page handoff and a 20-minute recorded walkthrough of the active project? Also list any outstanding access (cloud projects, analytics dashboards) that need reassignment. I'll handle PagerDuty and repo owners.

Maya Singh: Will upload the doc and recording by 2026-07-12. I'll include a list of cloud project IDs and dashboard owners.

Ethan (People Ops): Additional notes: final paycheck and accrued PTO payout are processed with the next payroll cycle. 401(k) admin contact and rollover instructions will be emailed. For equity/vesting questions contact equity@redwood.com. Exit interview: would you prefer Zoom or written?

Maya Singh: Zoom please. Morning of 2026-07-16 works. Can you share the exit questionnaire ahead of time?

Ethan (People Ops): Will DM the questionnaire and send a calendar invite for 2026-07-16 10:00am PT. offboard-bot: OFFBOARD-2030456789 created — IT, Manager, People Ops tasks assigned.

Priya (IT): Prepaid label sent to maya.s.personal+returns@gmail.com — FX tracking TX555666777 confirmed. Admin creds put into 1Password (shared with Rohit).

Maya Singh: Got the label and creds. Legal — thanks for the visa info, please DM me details. Appreciate the team's help.

offboard-bot: OFFBOARD-2030456789 status: in progress. Last update 2026-07-09 11:05:00 PT.
